remarks: Position your business for success in this well-appointed office space located within a multi-family building just minutes from the heart of Downtown Stamford. The functional layout features a front reception area that flows into a spacious rear office, divided by partial partition walls to create multiple workstations or semi-private offices while maintaining an open, collaborative feel. A full bathroom adds convenience for staff and clients. Heating is electric, and cooling is window air conditioning units provided by tenant. Ideal for professional, creative firms, consultants, wellness uses (subject to approvals), or other small business operations seeking a convenient location with easy access to Downtown Stamford, Metro-North, I-95, and local amenities.
